resources.string: Tap a conversation to open or reply. Add the widget from the launcher and choose a conversation.
OAuth messaging is available. Connect Discord to load supported DMs.
Notification mode is active. Add the Discord Social SDK package to enable OAuth DMs.
%1$s Tap Configure Discord OAuth for the exact setup requirements.

For OAuth DM reading and sending, this build needs a Discord Developer Application with Social SDK access, Public Client enabled, redirect URI %1$s, its application ID supplied as DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID, and Discord’s Android Social SDK package placed in app/discord_social_sdk. Notification widgets and notification replies remain available without OAuth.
The Discord application ID is not configured in this build.
Discord’s Android Social SDK package is not bundled in this build.
Discord’s Social SDK was found, but its native bridge did not initialize.
No browser is available to open the Discord Developer Portal.
Discord did not provide a reply action for this notification. Open Discord to reply.
No conversations yet. Enable notification access or connect through OAuth, then receive or refresh messages.
